findings.explanation: Principal-switch regression for member order history. The credential-bearing useResearch hook is replaced by a hoisted local session object; beforeEach installs a vi.fn fetch double that answers only the two declared local API paths and rejects other requests. The assigned token is an explicit synthetic customer marker, not an issued credential. No external identity service is involved.

Durable-checkout component test fixture. The short payment-intent client-secret literal uses an explicit fixture suffix and fixed synthetic provider reference. All HTTP is handled by a vi.stubGlobal fetch route table; unmatched requests throw, and card collection/authentication use injected provider doubles. This value is not acquired from a provider or an environment secret.

Payment-authentication component test fixture. A fixed synthetic payment-intent client secret is inserted into scripted continuation responses; global fetch is replaced by vi.fn and the authenticator is injected as a local test double. Assertions verify continuation behavior and non-disclosure, not a real provider authentication.

Local browser-qualification login helper. The password is the explicit native-preview fixture used solely for the preview-backend login path. The runner requires an explicit http://127.0.0.1 port origin, verifies synthetic-harness identity and exact build provenance, and drives an isolated browser network boundary. The literal authenticates only the companion process-local synthetic persona store.

Preview password in the explicit local synthetic preview fixture. The preview refuses NODE_ENV=production, removes ambient application credentials before importing application modules, binds its listener to 127.0.0.1, and rejects off-origin fetch/socket requests. Authentication is simulated by the in-process PERSONAS and activeTokens collections with invalid-domain emails; this is not a hosted or issued credential.

The adapter transport throws on any network attempt; repositories and execution inboxes are in memory. This tests signature verification without a real Stripe credential or provider request.
